question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

A slap on the wrist
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. A very mild punishment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"A slap on the wrist"** means a very mild punishment. (हल्की सजा)

 
 
• **Example:** The company received a slap on the wrist for violating safety regulations, with just a small fine imposed.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. A very mild punishment**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **A humble request** (विनम्र अनुरोध): A polite or modest appeal.

 
 
• **Example:** She made a humble request to the teacher for an extra day to complete her project.
 
 
 
• **A real awakening** (वास्तविक जागृति): An event that makes one aware of something important.
 
 
• **Example:** Losing his job was a real awakening for him to reconsider his career choices.
 
 
 
• **A disorganized person** (अव्यवस्थित व्यक्ति): Someone who lacks order or planning.
 
 
• **Example:** He is a disorganized person who often forgets important deadlines.
